name: ✦ VOIDRUSH ✦
description:
⚔️ VOIDRUSH — A CUSTOM RPG ADVENTURE IN THE VOID ⚔️

📱 Play on phone, tablet, console or PC. Bedrock and Java players share the same world!

The world is dissolving into the void, and only the strong push outward. VoidRush is a brand-new, fully custom RPG server: no vanilla grind, just classes, loot, bosses and a world that gets more dangerous the further you travel from spawn.

🗡️ 13 UNIQUE CLASSES

Warrior, Mage, Archer, Assassin, Berserker, Wraith, Monk, Lancer, Shieldwall and more. Each has its own abilities and a talent tree with specialization branches and a capstone.

👹 7 EPIC BOSSES

Multi-phase fights with real mechanics, from the Void Sentinel to the Hollow King and beyond. Bring friends.

🏰 DUNGEONS & RIFTS

Generated dungeon runs with themed rooms, shrines and dungeon bosses guarding the best loot.

🌌 TIERED VOID WORLD

Zones grow deadlier with distance. Level up to unlock Tier 2 through Tier 6 gear, then chase Legendaries at level 65.

⛏️ PROFESSIONS & CRAFTING

Mining, Woodcutting, Herbalism, Fishing, Alchemy and Blacksmithing. Level your tools, find gems and socket them into your gear.

🏴 OUTPOSTS & PVP

Capture outposts for your group, but watch your reputation: kill too many innocents and you turn Chaotic.

🏠 MORE TO DO

Your own Realm to build in • Guilds & parties • Auction house • Quests • Pets • World events like Meteor Showers • Loot goblins

🎁 VOTE DAILY

Every vote gives you a Vote Key for the Vote Crate at spawn. Rewards scale with your tier: Void Coins, XP, XP and profession boosts, runes, gems, accessories, storage bags and loot boxes. Hit a jackpot for the Golden Balloon pet, the [Voter] chat tag, a Gigantic Storage Bag or an XP boost for the whole server.

👉 JOIN NOW

Bedrock: play.voidrush.org (port 19132)

Java: play.voidrush.org
